greeting: Good morning, Dan. Just one recruiter call sits on today's calendar, which leaves a wide-open middle — a good day to clear the holiday-travel bookings that have slipped past their dates.

needsAttention.detail: Your own book-by date for the Dec 13–Jan 2 stretch with all four girls is today, and holiday inventory for six over three weeks is the thinnest of the year. Pick domestic-vs-international and let the booking go out.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: Still unbooked, well past its book-this-week date. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week sells out; a refundable hold now takes the whole risk off the table.
